title: Мирика из Окинавы
alt: Shimanchu MiRiKa Special 島んちゅMiRiKa
description: An original anime project promoting the local Okinawa agricultural and industrial businesses and sponsored by the Okinawa Prefecture. Set in Japan's Okinawa Prefecture the story is about three girls who are into music, dance, Okinawan stage productions and karate.
